messages:
aisha: quick RFC follow-up idea: per-layer byte-bound overlays for safetensors so we can ship tiny fixes without full shard rewrites.

matt: sounds useful. overlays applied in-memory only or can materialize to disk? how do we verify?

aisha: two modes: ephemeral in-memory for fast rollouts, optional materialize-to-disk for stable patches. verification via sidecar manifest with base cid, touched ranges, and expected post-apply digests.

hao: atomicity worry: mid-apply crash could expose mixed state. need atomic swap semantics.

sophie: reuse namespace/lease swap: publish overlay as revision, switch pointer after successful verify.

kevin: heavy for tiny 4KB fixes. want streaming-apply + quick revert.

aisha: streaming-apply plan: download overlay, validate signature, apply to ephemeral pages, verify per-range hashes, then atomic pointer swap. abort on failure.

matt: pseudo: `fetch -> verify -> apply_ranges -> verify_ranges -> swap`

hao: post-verify must be O(patch_size). include per-range merkle hashes in sidecar to avoid full-shard checks.

sophie: per-range hashes enable partial streaming and lazy fetch; tradeoff: more metadata.

kevin: keep sidecar external to avoid format changes. sidecar fields: base_cid, overlay_cid, ranges[], range_hashes[], signed_by.

aisha: perf: avoid full copy. runtime can map base read-only + overlay pages and use small indirection table so unchanged pages stay zero-copy.

matt: indirection lookup cost minimal if cached per worker. add timeout fallback to base shard to avoid tail latencies.

hao: cross-platform mmap/COW is tricky. mitigation: min overlay chunk size (64KB), GC old overlays, provide materialize tool.

sophie: ops UI: preview endpoint to dry-run overlay on sample prompts before rollout.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: overlay publish requires signed bundle + manifest entry; canary progression 1%->10%->100% with health checks.

aisha: next steps: write RFC follow-up with sidecar JSON schema, range-digest format (sha256 chunks / optional tree), runtime indirection ABI, apply state machine, telemetry hooks, and a short spike POC checklist. ping me with thoughts. :sparkles:
